headline.en: Rodri trained in the gym, away from the main group
headline.es: Rodri trabajo en el gimnasio, fuera del grupo

summary.en: SPORT said Rodri trained on his own again on Saturday and did gym work. The club set that plan when he arrived after the World Cup. He played a few minutes against Athletic. That was his first appearance. It does not mean he is ready for a full week.
summary.es: SPORT dijo que Rodri volvio a trabajar al margen el sabado. Los minutos ante el Athletic fueron su primera aparicion.

body.en: Rodri joined Barcelona after the World Cup. The club put him on a separate training plan so the load would rise slowly. SPORT reported from the Ciutat Esportiva that he trained apart again on Saturday and used the gym. He came on against Athletic in a 2-0 win. The game was already going Barcelona's way. Those minutes were a first look, not a full return. Pedri is already starting in midfield. Gavi missed Saturday after the knock at Elche. If Flick starts Rodri against Rayo and then again in the first European week, the risk is a muscle problem in September. The plan for now is still gym work and limited minutes. There is no new injury report. There is also no sign he will start on Monday.

tweets.text: Rodri continua con su plan especifico. Volvio a entrenarse al margen del grupo.

tweets.name: Pol Ballus
tweets.text: Limited minutes for Rodri this week. The gym plan is still on.

tweets.name: BarcaFutbolLive
tweets.text: Cameo against Athletic. Saturday he was back in individual work.

headline.en: Atletico will not sell Julian Alvarez to Barcelona
headline.es: El Atletico no vendera a Julian Alvarez al Barca

summary.en: Atletico Madrid still will not negotiate Julian Alvarez. Ramon Fuentes wrote in Mundo Deportivo that decree 1006 would not automatically punish a forced exit. That is a legal note, not a deal. Flick is using Raphinha and Ferran Torres as the reference in attack.
summary.es: El Atletico no negocia a Alvarez. Fuentes escribio sobre el decreto 1006. No hay pacto. Flick sigue con Raphinha y Ferran.

body.en: Atletico Madrid have not opened talks on Julian Alvarez. Flick, Deco and Laporta have already said they will not chase a striker Atletico will not sell. Ramon Fuentes wrote in Mundo Deportivo that Spanish decree 1006 would not automatically sanction Alvarez or Barcelona if he tried to leave. That is a legal reading. It is not an offer and it is not a contract. Arsenal clause talk has not been confirmed by Atletico. Barcelona have started the Liga season without a classic centre-forward. Raphinha and Ferran Torres are the players Flick is using high up the pitch. Until Atletico change their position, there is no Alvarez transfer to write. The team is already playing without him.

headline.en: Barcelona play Rayo on Monday at 21:30. Gavi missed Saturday training
headline.es: El Barca juega contra el Rayo el lunes a las 21:30. Gavi no entrenó el sabado

summary.en: Barcelona host Rayo Vallecano on Monday at 21:30. Mundo Deportivo said Livakovic was in Saturday's session and Gavi was not, after the knock at Elche. Pedri has already covered that midfield role. Barcelona have two wins from two.
summary.es: El Barca recibe al Rayo el lunes a las 21:30. Livakovic si estuvo el sabado. Gavi no. Pedri ya cubrio ese puesto.

body.en: Rayo Vallecano visit Camp Nou on Monday at 21:30. It is Barcelona's first midweek Liga match of the season. Mundo Deportivo reported that Livakovic trained with the group on Saturday and Gavi did not. Gavi left the Elche match with a knee problem. Flick said the first reading was not as serious as it looked. Pedri started against Athletic and can start again. Rodri is still on a separate gym plan. Rayo usually defend deep and attack the space behind the full-backs. That is a different game to Elche and Athletic. Barcelona have scored seven and conceded none. Monday will show if they can break a low block. Squad news closer to kickoff will confirm Gavi.
